_comment_Admins: Inherent administrators of this deployment - the full explanation is on the same key in appsettings.json. Restated here rather than inherited because .NET configuration merges arrays BY INDEX: a development-only list would silently replace entry 0 of the base file rather than adding to it, so the two have to be read together anyway. Deployment-owned, not club-owned; not a secret, but security-relevant, because editing it changes who administers every club on the deployment.
